body: As you know, I’m “all in” when it comes to commitment to environmental stewardship. At our house, we recycle, compost, switch lightbulbs, drive a hybrid, etc., etc. But the fact that I do so much flying for my work continues to bug me. So, we’ve been experimenting with having me “appear” at some “appearances” through digital media … Here’s what a recent event looked like – thanks to Texas Impact!
